input.query: WITH rates AS (SELECT channel, months_since_activation, sum(n_active)::DOUBLE/sum(cohort_size) retention FROM agg_retention_cohorts WHERE months_since_activation BETWEEN 6 AND 12 GROUP BY 1,2), avg_rates AS (SELECT channel, avg(retention) steady_retention_6_12 FROM rates GROUP BY 1), economics AS (SELECT channel, sum(avg_margin_eur) FILTER (WHERE months_since_activation <= 28) AS observed_ltv_28m, max(cac_eur) cac FROM agg_unit_economics GROUP BY 1) SELECT a.channel, a.steady_retention_6_12, e.observed_ltv_28m, e.cac, e.observed_ltv_28m-e.cac AS net_margin FROM avg_rates a JOIN economics e USING(channel) ORDER BY 1
